_doc: Hero line (spec #296, H2 #298), books 111/112 (and 100/110 skills moved here only when a Hero ticket ports them). H5 (Power Strike, Slash Blast, Brandish), H6 (Rush), H7 (Shout, Monster Magnet) and H8 (Panic, Coma) each append their own entries as one group. Power Strike and Slash Blast stay in warrior.json until H5 ports them.

shout._rarity: Tier C: first-pass #303 bonuses named after the lineage (spec #296): Rare area x1.2, Epic Booster cooldown x0.88, Unique Echo Shout cooldown x0.75, Legendary Echo Shout plus area x1.2 (sharing the Unique's id and repeat counter). Repeat scale 0.8. See GAME_DESIGN 8 and 7.33.
shout._provenance: Tier A: Skill.wz 1111008 damage 14 to 30 %, mobCount 6, the centred box (-110..-200, -82..-150) to (110..200, 83..150), prop (stun chance 52 to 95 %), time (stun seconds 5 to 10), the alert3 action, effect and hit art, the Use sound and the stun stars (`mob`). Tier C: the explicit `ranks` table (D4): level 4 stores its prop under the stray key "58" (String.wz agrees with 58 %, so the key is a corrupted `prop`), so rank 1 reads level 5 (60 %) instead; the 12 s cooldown, the three-mob admission gate and the 0.6 s action hold. Docs: GAME_DESIGN 7.33.
shout.name: Shout
shout.desc: Roars at the monsters around you, hurting and stunning them.

text.desc: Roar at the crowd around you to damage and stun up to 6 monsters. Needs 3 monsters in the roar's box.
text.h: Damage {damage}%, up to {mob_count|monster|monsters}; {prop}% chance each to stun for {time} sec.

monster_magnet._rarity: Tier C: first-pass #303 bonuses (spec #296): Rare reach x1.2 (the `range` modifier: a range_around cast reads `range`, never `area`), Epic Bigger Grab +2 targets, Unique Booster cooldown x0.75, Legendary Booster plus +2 targets (sharing the Unique's id and repeat counter). Repeat scale 0.8. See GAME_DESIGN 8 and 7.33.
monster_magnet._provenance: Tier A: Skill.wz 1121001 range 200 to 400 px, prop (pull chance 48 to 95 %), mobCount 6, the 18-frame effect and the Use sound. Tier C: no damage (the node has none); pulling is the shared `pull` block (7.35); the alert2 action (the node names none; its `prepare` dash makes a two-handed axe vanish, H1 #297), the 10 s cooldown, the three-mob admission gate (`cast.min_targets`, any mob in range counts, pulled or not) and the 0.6 s action hold. Docs: GAME_DESIGN 7.33.
monster_magnet.name: Monster Magnet
monster_magnet.desc: Drags the monsters around you toward you.

text.desc: Drag distant monsters toward you, into reach of your other skills. Needs 3 monsters in range.
